Use rvr-dev (CLI) / rvr-dev-mcp (MCP) for local testing — never the prod `rvr` binary in dev. Beta channel is `rvr-beta` (currently 1.0.0-beta.1; this project's own .mcp.json points its MCP server at `rvr-beta`). Release: git tag triggers CI.

Renamed from cclid / cclid-mcp on 2026-05-07 as part of clearing C-bucket residue post-rebrand. See project.storeResidueC for the broader sweep.
